about: Sentences said while task agents wait for the user to answer, to measure how they are read (decision.LexicalDecisionModel.read_answer). 'questions': what waits, by set (and language), as the ledger keeps it: the title of the commission that asks, and its question. 'sentences': what is handed over while those wait; 'answers' is the number of the question it answers, 'unsure' when it answers one of several without saying which, null when it is new work; 'choice' is what a request for approval chose (either is right when two are given). 'by': 'self' was written by the session that wrote the reading, 'independent' by a model that knew nothing of it, from the questions as the user sees them. Sets: beside, hand_over, start_team (written for the word lists that read answers before, labelled with the choice since); run_command (an agent asks to run npm run build); open_question (an agent asks which colour); several (three wait at once).
